# Block reference

<!-- Generated by `gdl docs blocks`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Use a block three ways:

```
block("spike", 45, 15)        // by name
obj(B_SPIKE, 45, 15)          // by constant (every name is also B_<NAME> in capitals)
rect(B_BASIC, 15, 15, 4, 3)   // fill a 4x3 grid, 30 units apart
```

Not in the list? `obj(id, x, y)` takes any object id.
